note: Tranche-2 capture for M1078A1R SOCOM SOV. Every value is grade claimed: the validator admits a tier-4 manufacturer source and a tier-5 compilation at claimed only, and the dataset tier note is carried in each value state. The retired capture-level sources array stays empty.

operating_weight_kg.locator: Datasheet, 'Vehicle Curb Weight with Fuel: 17,214 lb (7,808 kg)'. No SOCOM SOV-specific weight is published anywhere found; the base M1078A1R 2.5-ton cargo figure is used as the operating basis.
operating_weight_kg.state: operating weight as published; source tier-4 manufacturer datasheet; caveat: operating_weight_kg: NO SOCOM SOV-specific weight is published. The base M1078A1R cargo curb weight (7,808 kg) is carried at grade documented for the base vehicle but the SOCOM kit mass is unknown.

curb_weight_kg.locator: Datasheet, 'Vehicle Curb Weight with Fuel: 17,214 lb (7,808 kg)'
curb_weight_kg.state: curb weight, no crew and no payload as published; source tier-4 manufacturer datasheet

gross_weight_kg.locator: Datasheet, curb 17,214 lb plus payload 5,000 lb = 22,214 lb (10,076 kg); derived.
gross_weight_kg.state: gross vehicle weight rating as published; source tier-4 manufacturer datasheet; the research dataset marked this value derived; it is not directly published, and the validator admits a real-world derived value as claimed

length_mm.locator: Datasheet, 'Length: 235 in (6,420 mm)'. Note the printed inch figure (235 in = 5,969 mm) disagrees with the printed metric figure (6,420 mm); the metric figure is recorded.
length_mm.state: overall length as published; source tier-4 manufacturer datasheet; caveat: length_mm: the datasheet prints '235 in (6,420 mm)', an internal inconsistency (235 in = 5,969 mm). The metric figure is recorded; the imperial figure is suspect.
